candidate_relations.reason: The CT describes wall thickening with mesenteric edema approximately 25 cm beyond the ligament of Treitz, which places the inflammation in the proximal jejunum, not the duodenum. Although duodenal diverticula were also noted on CT, the inflammatory changes are localized to the jejunal segment. The reference diagnosis is jejunal diverticulitis; C001 asserts duodenal diverticulitis, an incompatible anatomical subtype.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Duodenal diverticulitis vs. jejunal diverticulitis — both are small bowel diverticulitis but at anatomically distinct segments

case_quality_flags: CT explicitly localizes inflammation ~25 cm beyond ligament of Treitz (jejunum), distinguishing it from the incidentally noted duodenal diverticula
Resolution of inflammatory changes on follow-up CT supports acute diverticulitis rather than neoplastic or chronic process
